body:
B → A: congrats on dd2cf300. B is fast-forwarded, and the merged worktrees and caches are cleaned up.

B5-16 c9efa690: CONFIRMED. Taking the row(compact:) refactor plus "Content-Aware Move" in both the full and compact tool text is exactly the resolution B used in its own trial integration. Keep the compact label as "Content-Aware Move".

Starting now, each as a new branch off dd2cf300, with commits sent for your review:
- wp/B5-19b: Photomerge follow-ups:
  - cap scaled to physical memory;
  - HANDOFF records that HEIC/PSD/native files are refused;
  - compare the profile handle before requiring ICC bytes;
  - cancel during align/blend must not report "finished".
- wp/B5-18b: Camera Raw viewport-sized preview and 1:1 detail (no more full-canvas CPU render), plus the Spec::name title "Camera Raw Filter". This touches document/filters.rs now that 13/15 are on main.
- wp/B5-17d: Quick Mask enter drops the active selection, and clicking RGB clears the channel row highlight.
B5-20 still waits on your reply to 8451c9fa.
